title: Loop terminal renderer trust-boundary repair
owner: repository owner; merge and promotion require an explicit owner decision
primary_acceptance_claim: Every runtime-derived field emitted by the loop terminal renderer is projected through one neutral helper to a single printable-ASCII field of at most 160 characters including any ellipsis, while canonical LoopReport and IterationResult evidence remains byte-for-byte semantically unchanged.

branch_policy.containment_note: The pre-existing canonical branch history from closed PR #293 remains in ancestry. A two-parent, non-force merge advanced that line onto main commit 8dea59782afc9ba275a28cbc00c455b088f254d0 before this packet was applied.

forbidden_paths: artifact, event, evidence, graph, policy, promotion, registry, receipt, and store authorities

contracts.input: any object accepted only for presentation through str(value)
contracts.output: one line containing only ASCII code points 0x20 through 0x7e
normalization_order: collapse whitespace to single ASCII spaces
encode non-ASCII text with deterministic question-mark replacement
defensively replace every remaining non-printable code point
truncate the sanitized field to 160 characters including a three-character ASCII ellipsis
rejected_terminal_semantics: C0 controls including NUL, BEL, ESC, CR, and LF
DEL and C1 controls including CSI
Unicode bidirectional and invisible format controls
contracts.canonical_evidence: No report, iteration, skipped-item, note, receipt, serialization, or persisted value is rewritten; sanitization is presentation-only.
contracts.architecture: The helper is a neutral package-level presentation primitive. daedalus.loop does not import or depend on private evaluator code, and the change creates no effect authority, registry, receipt, or store.

acceptance_matrix.acceptance: C0, DEL/C1, bidi/format controls, multiline input, and lone surrogates produce only one-line printable ASCII and remain UTF-8 encodable
acceptance_matrix.budget: all tested cases complete in the focused suite; no I/O or provider call

acceptance_matrix.acceptance: sanitization precedes truncation and the complete field, including '...', is at most 160 characters
every report, iteration, branch, skipped-item, and note text surface uses the same contract under combined C0/C1/bidi/format/surrogate/long-string injection
acceptance_matrix.budget: 17 named text surfaces; 160 characters per field; zero canonical mutations

acceptance_matrix.acceptance: LoopReport.to_dict() is deeply equal before and after rendering for every injected surface
loop imports the neutral helper and contains neither a duplicate local helper nor an evaluator dependency

acceptance_matrix.test: focused and broad loop regression commands in evidence.verification
acceptance_matrix.acceptance: existing loop bounds, governance, lease, spend, envelope, and web API behavior remains green
acceptance_matrix.budget: focused <= 60 seconds; selected broad loop suite <= 120 seconds

refusal_tests: raw ESC/CSI/BEL/NUL cannot reach terminal output
DEL and every C1 byte-class code point cannot reach terminal output
Unicode bidi and invisible format controls cannot reach terminal output
lone surrogates cannot make rendered output fail ASCII or UTF-8 encoding
a runtime-derived field longer than 160 sanitized characters cannot render without truncation
fault_injections: DEL and all C1 code points 0x7f-0x9f
lone high and low surrogates U+D800 and U+DFFF
combined adversarial prefixes followed by 500 printable characters on every named render surface

migration.current: Replace the loop-local partial C0/C1 helper with daedalus.text_integrity.safe_terminal_text and route every runtime-derived render field through it.
migration.parallel_291_convergence: The local #291 repair established the same printable-ASCII and 160-character contract in a private evaluator helper. On integration, that consumer should import this neutral helper so the private duplicate can be deleted; loop must never import daedalus.eval._text_integrity.
migration.compatibility: Canonical report and iteration schemas and serialized evidence remain unchanged; terminal presentation intentionally becomes more defensive and more tightly bounded.

rollback.procedure: Revert only the four in-scope paths from the remediation commit.
rollback.data_cleanup: none; the change creates no persistent state or migration
rollback.negative_evidence_retention: Retain the baseline bidi, surrogate, and unbounded-output reproductions in this packet even if the implementation is rolled back.

expected_failures: Exact-head hosted CI for 47229f0a230111ad1be29cbd5f976dcc31c02859 is a zero-step infrastructure failure and supplies no product evidence.
Linux and the remaining supported interpreter matrix are not established by Windows CPython 3.10 local evidence and remain required before release.
Objects whose __str__ raises are outside the LoopReport/IterationResult schema contract; this presentation packet does not convert arbitrary execution failures into evidence.
review_questions: Does every runtime-derived terminal field pass through the neutral helper after formatting and before interpolation?
Can C0, C1, bidi/format controls, or lone surrogates survive in any rendered output?
Is the 160-character bound measured after sanitization and inclusive of the ellipsis?
Does rendering preserve canonical evidence exactly for every adversarial surface?
Is the helper neutral rather than coupled to private evaluator code, and can the parallel #291 duplicate converge on it?
Does this packet add any execution, effect, evidence, policy, promotion, receipt, registry, or storage authority?
Are hosted CI limitations stated as blockers rather than represented as green evidence?
